headline: Industrial Park Real Estate Enterprises: Safe Leverage, Diverging Cash Flows
summary: VIS Rating says industrial park real estate firms kept leverage at a safe level in the first half of 2026. Large players such as BCM and KBC face cash flow deficits from multi-sector projects.
why: Industrial park developers supply factory land to foreign and domestic manufacturers, so their finances reflect the health of Vietnam's manufacturing investment pipeline. Leverage and cash flow are key credit metrics.
